tab.modeJogTip: Jog while held, or by a step. Keyboard: arrows X/Y, Page Up/Down Z.
tab.modeFeedTip: Feed one axis to the soft limit or a set distance
tab.modePositionsTip: Save machine positions and go back to them
tab.continuousTip: Jog while the button or key is held
tab.homeAllTip: Home all axes using the configured sequence
tab.crossMarkFirst: Move {axis} across its reference mark first
tab.enterSpindleSpeed: Enter a spindle speed above zero
tab.materialProbeUnavailable: Material probing is unavailable on this machine.
tab.mdiPlaceholder: G-code, for example G0 X0 Y0
tab.spindleSpeedEffect: Applies this RPM immediately if the spindle is running. When stopped, sets the speed for the next start.

dro.switchToWorkPosition: Switch to work position to touch off
dro.touchOffEffect: Changes the {wcs} work offset so that {axis} reads the value below at the present position. The machine does not move.

coordinateConfirm.effect: Changes the {wcs} work offset at the present position. The machine does not move.

powerFeed.tipLimit: Power feed {direction} to the soft limit
powerFeed.machineMoved: The machine moved. Tap the direction again
powerFeed.toLimitTip: Stop {margin} mm inside the soft limit
powerFeed.feedEffect: Feed per minute of the next power feed.
powerFeed.distanceEffect: Distance of the next power feed.
powerFeed.confirmLimit: Machine coordinates. Stops {margin} mm inside the soft limit.
powerFeed.confirmDistance: Machine coordinates. Stays inside the soft limits.

positions.saveFailed: The positions could not be saved
positions.stepXY: Move X Y to X {x}  Y {y}
positions.stepLiftTop: Lift Z to the top of travel (safe Z) {z}
positions.name: Name
positions.nameHint: Machine coordinates, saved for this machine. An empty name saves as {name}.
positions.alreadyThere: The machine is already at this position.
positions.rapidNote: Rapid moves in machine coordinates, {unit}. Z first goes up to a safe height.

workSystems.makeActive: Make {wcs} active. The machine does not move.
workSystems.shiftAll: This shift applies to every work coordinate system. G92 and G52 share these offset values in LinuxCNC.
workSystems.shiftKept: Zero and Half adjust the selected work offset and leave this shift in place. LinuxCNC may retain it after a restart.

macros.title: Macros
macros.hint: Runs as one MDI command. The result shows in the MDI history.

moves.noStatus: No status from the machine yet
moves.feedAboveMax: The feed is above the machine maximum
moves.safeZRange: Safe Z must be within the Z soft limits, {min} to {max} {unit}
moves.noXyz: This machine has no X, Y and Z axes
moves.savedOutside: The saved {axis} is outside the soft limits
moves.safeZOutside: The safe Z for Go to is outside the Z soft limits. Change it in Settings
moves.nameTooLong: Enter a name of at most {bytes} bytes
moves.tooMany: At most {count} positions. Delete one first

sequence.stoppedEarly: Go to stopped before the position was reached
